title: Meet Jaime Tan Cruz, business partner of the Duterte family
summary: Here are the ties that bind Jaime Tan Cruz to Vice President Sara Duterte, Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte, Congressman Pulong Duterte, and former president Rodrigo Duterte.

blocks.text: Here are the ties that bind Jaime Tan Cruz to Vice President Sara Duterte, Davao City Mayor Baste Duterte, Congressman Pulong Duterte, and former president Rodrigo Duterte.

MANILA, Philippines – Meet businessman Jaime Tan Cruz and see his connections to the Duterte family, from Vice President Sara, Davao City Mayor Baste, and congressman Pulong to former president Rodrigo Duterte.
Watch this report from Rappler’s Patrick Cruz. – Rappler.com
